newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RUSSIA NOVOSIBIRSK ELEKTROSVYAZ TO CONSIDER ADRS.
newsitem.headline: RUSSIA NOVOSIBIRSK ELEKTROSVYAZ TO CONSIDER ADRS.

text.p: The board of Russian regional telecoms company Novosibirsk Elektrosvyaz will consider at a meeting this autumn issuing level-one American Depositary Receipts, the director of marketing said on Thursday.

Alexander Perepelitsa also said the company would increase charter capital to 291.250 billion roubles ($50 million) from 194.172 billion by year end through redenominating share nominal value to 15,000 roubles each from the current 10,000 roubles.
Shareholders had approved the revaluation at the annual meeting in May.
Perepelitsa did not give any details of the programme for ADRs, share look-alikes which trade abroad and increase stock liquidity. "The question will be decided in the autumn," he said.
Novosibirsk Elektrosvyaz posted net profits calculated to Russian standards on an accruals basis of 129.2 billion roubles in 1996 against 57 billion roubles in 1995.
The company paid 335 roubles in 1996 dividends on each ordinary share with a 10,000 rouble face value and 2,662 roubles on each preferred share. ($ = 5,807 roubles)
